description: Gerard Callenburgstraat 2-32, Jan den Haenstraat 3-31 and Joris van Andringastraat 1-32 (BAG 1934): 12.8 m red-brick blocks of two mirrored houses, three storeys under a flat roofline with large zinc dormers: on each upper storey a pair of windows (1.2 and 1.15 m) at either end and two tall slot lights (0.5 m, 3.9-9.0 m) of the stair pair in the middle; ground: two small windows at each end and four house doors in pairs under one flat canopy at 2.5 m

match.note: BAG 1933-34, 3DBAG eaves 10.0-10.3 m, ridge 12.7-13.0 m (the dormers). The 4.5-6.5 m end pands, the 17-19 m pands and Callenburg 39-63 (eaves 13.1 m, five storeys) are other fronts

zinc-dormers.note: two painted-zinc box dormers per block (round-4 review): a 3-light glass band about 2.0 m wide in a 2.4 m box, smooth mid-grey cheeks #6f7275, a dark flat cap #3e4144 overhanging 0.15 m, about 1.6 m high with the cap; none on Callenburgstraat 3-63, which takes the plain crown "parapet"

parapet.note: Callenburgstraat 2-32 strip: a dark thin eaves band at 10.0-10.15 m; the zinc dormers (2.2 m wide, 10.1-12.2 m, two per block) are not drawn

door-left.note: house doors in pairs under one flat canopy at 2.5 m (3.8-8.8 m of the block), flat doors 0-2.4 m; ground windows 1.0-2.66 m at each end; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the right; doorRow: four 0.75 m doors side by side across 0.32-0.69 of the front single leaves without a fanlight under one continuous canopy slab resting on the door heads (Opus round-3 verdict)

roof.evidence: Callenburgstraat 2-32 strip: flat eaves band with two zinc dormers per block, 3DBAG ridge 12.8 m

rhythm.bays: pair, slot, slot, pair per block
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: 2 windows + doors + 2 windows | 1-2: pair, two slots, pair
rhythm.groundFloor: four doors in two pairs under a canopy

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023-24 40 px/m gridded 1 m (grid crop 0-1000 px): block 12.8 m; windows 0.5-1.7, 2.05-3.2, 9.5-10.6, 11.0-12.1 m; slots 5.4-5.9 and 6.7-7.25 m, 3.9-9.0 m high; sills/heads 3.9-5.6 and 6.85-8.6 m; ground windows 1.0-2.66 m; canopy 2.5 m; eaves 10.1 m; dormers 10.1-12.2 m; wall raw #704226

schemaLimits: the tall slot lights run through both upper storeys; drawn as one narrow window per storey
four doors in two pairs under one canopy: one door and a window are drawn
the zinc dormers (10.1-12.2 m) are not drawn
notes: Palette: type default red-brown; placed pands take their trim-normalised strip wall.
